checks: Every exchange is saved on this PC with a short title; a reopened Lin gets the last turns back and the latest conversation to pick up
“What did we talk about yesterday?” and topic questions find the right turns; ordinary questions are not mistaken for recall
“Don’t save this conversation” stops saving it (nothing is written); “start saving again” resumes
Forgetting asks first, removes the turns from every search at once, Undo restores them for 10 minutes, then they are erased from the file
Every recall answer says which saved conversations were searched, that notes, tasks and calendar were not, and that private chats were never saved
A dated fact you mention (“my defense is on November 12”) becomes a suggested memory card; questions and undated remarks do not
A quiet conversation gets a one-line summary once; it is not summarised again until something new is said
